caption: A vacuum cleaner nozzle is run over crumbs scattered on a carpet, and the crumbs disappear into the nozzle.

sa.check: Crumbs are scattered on a carpet.
A vacuum cleaner nozzle is run over them.
The crumbs disappear into the nozzle.
The nozzle passes first and the crumbs go after.

pc.expect: Crumbs jump toward the nozzle only when it comes close and vanish into it.
pc.fail: Crumbs vanish before the nozzle nears; or the nozzle passes and the crumbs stay; or crumbs vanish elsewhere on the carpet.

pc.expect: The carpet is clean behind the nozzle's path and crumbs do not reappear.
pc.fail: Crumbs reappear behind the nozzle; or new crumbs appear; or the carpet stays covered after the pass.

pc.expect: Crumbs move toward the nozzle mouth, not away.
pc.fail: They fly away from the nozzle; or sideways; or straight up.

pc.expect: Crumbs stay still until the nozzle nears.
pc.fail: Crumbs move about before the nozzle comes; or the carpet ripples; or crumbs hop with the nozzle far away.

pc.expect: One nozzle keeps its number and does not pass through the carpet.
pc.fail: It passes through the carpet; or duplicates; or the carpet tears open.

pc.expect: The carpet's pattern and the nozzle stay the same.
pc.fail: The carpet changes pattern; or the nozzle changes; or the room rearranges.
